title: KILLA – Frosted Mint
description:
KILLA DRY FROSTED MINT is an incredible menthol ice storm of emotion and extra strength.

It allows you to get an unreal freshness combined with light dryness.

Just a fantastic choice for fans of drier nicotine pouches

Your teeth, gums and lungs will not be significantly harmed
Try Killa and all your doubts will disappear at once.
